event_chain.summary: Unauthorized access to limited customer data via mobile app

summary: In June 2026 United International Transportation Co. (Budget Saudi), the Saudi car rental company, disclosed on Tadawul that it had detected unauthorized access to a limited portion of certain customers' data through its mobile application. The company activated its security protocols, contained the incident and began a technical assessment with the relevant authorities. It said no customer or company financial or banking information was affected and there was no financial or operational impact.
